title: コンベア式卓上トースター
description: ホテル朝食会場や食堂の調理台に置くコンベア式トースター。上部の装填開口と固定ワイヤーベルト、端のローラー/ガイド、下側の傾斜した返却シュート、三つの無目盛ダイヤル、天面通気外形、裏面の留め具/電源口と四脚を造形しています。ワイヤーは実ジオメトリで、ベルトや食品は動きません。パンは含まず一式1点。カウンターの高さに合わせて配置し、加熱・搬送・食品安全の機能を持たない静的小物として使用してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.484 × 0.475 × 0.655 m、10,908三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A conveyor toaster for hotel breakfast counters and cafeterias. It has an upper loading opening with a fixed geometric wire belt, end rollers/guides, a lower sloped return chute, three unnumbered dials, top ventilation exteriors, rear fasteners/power inlet and four feet. The wires are real geometry; belt and food motion are absent. No bread is supplied and the assembly counts once. Adjust counter placement height and use as a static prop without heating, transport or food-safety functionality. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.484 × 0.475 × 0.655 m; 10,908 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
